water_cells_above_ground.note: dry cells below MSL are diked/hydro-flattened land or OSM land; no water surface is drawn there

C12_buildings.threshold: every base within 0.5 m of the local terrain minimum; watertight (EditMode test); no z-fighting at 10 m-3 km
C12_buildings.skirt: walls extend 2 m below base so the LOD terrain (max error 0.2 m) never shows a gap

C13_roads_faults.threshold: roads with class/width; bridges/tunnels flagged (decks not draped on the ground); global faults baked; tile clip empty by design
C13_roads_faults.rendering: roads are painted into the terrain albedo (no coplanar geometry, no flicker); bridge and tunnel ways are not drawn at M0 (deck heights are not in the data; F-041)

C14_removal.threshold: 20 random buildings removed at runtime by bid; all others and the terrain identical in the export

C16_spec.threshold: 2049^2 pixel-is-point, float64 origin multiple of 2048 m, LOD level field, shared edge rows byte-identical, second tile bakes

bay_4624_tiles.note: Q-027 default: 1 m only for urban/shoreline tiles, 2 m (L1) elsewhere; streaming loads ~9 tiles around the focus

C20_budgets.threshold: <= 1.5 M triangles, <= 1,500 draw calls (target 200), <= 100 MB committed, bake <= 5 min, editor build <= 60 s (Assumed budgets)

C5_default_share_mitigation.proposal: Q-NEW (T-003): allow a DataSF match when >= 80 % of the OSM footprint lies inside one DataSF footprint (row houses split in OSM); not applied without founder approval

summary.note: M-005 passes only if every sub-measure passes (R-004 §6); not_applicable_in_tile items are due at M1 and are not passes.
